description.value: A large-format Walmart Supercentre located in Richmond, BC, offering a full grocery department alongside electronics, clothing, toys, and household goods. As a three-level Supercentre it is one of the larger Walmart formats in the Lower Mainland, giving touring cyclists access to a wide range of resupply options under one roof. Accepts cash, credit, and debit.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 69m; rack at 86m.
